basic_details.job_title: IISER Kolkata Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Librarian, Deputy Librarian Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Kolkata (IISER Kolkata), Mohanpur, West Bengal, has invited applications for 2 posts in 2 roles under Advt No. IISER-K/Admn./NT-06/2026. The posts include Librarian, Deputy Librarian. The online application is open from 10 October 2026 to 31 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: How Will IISER Kolkata Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Online application submission and document screening Shortlisting based on qualifications and experience Interview Applications screened on academic and professional attainments; essential qualifications alone do not entitle a candidate to interview. Number called for interview may be restricted on the basis of qualifications and experience higher than the minimum. Shortlisting based on objective criteria, which may vary from category to category. Screening-cum-Shortlisting Committee decides relevancy of experience; its decision is final. IISER Kolkata reserves the right to cancel or introduce any examination/Personal Interview/other selection process.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of relevant testimonials, certificates, enclosures

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISER Kolkata Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online through the link: https://iiserkolnt.samarth.edu.in/index.php/site/login. Pay the application fee through the payment gateway. Send the hard-copy of the downloaded PDF of the filled application form along with self-attested copies of testimonials and certificates by speed post/registered post/courier. Super-scribe the envelope as 'APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF [Post Name]'. Apply on or before 31 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates working in Central/State Government Organizations must send the print out through proper channel and Vigilance Certificate or produce NOC. Separate application and fee must be submitted for applying to more than one post.
